20261122-physics-e2-1.material: [Advanced thinking] Dem put alarm clock inside vacuum glass jar wey dem don comot all di air from, then dem make di alarm ring. Di clock hammer dey shake and dey hit di bell but dem no hear any sound at all. Wetin be di reason?
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced thinking] Dem put alarm clock inside vacuum glass jar wey dem don comot all di air from, then dem make di alarm ring. Di clock hammer dey shake and dey hit di bell but dem no hear any sound at all. Wetin be di reason?
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.explain: Sound dey travel through vibration of material (medium) like air, so for vacuum wey no get air, sound no fit travel.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.0: For sound to reach our ear, e need something wey go carry am like air.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Vacuum no get any gas molecule at all.
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.o.o0: Because no air (medium) dey to carry di sound
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.o.o1: Because sound dey change to light inside vacuum
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.o.o2: Because di glass wall absorb all di sound
20261122-physics-e2-1.s.s1.o.o3: Because di vibration of di clock don too fast
